blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Think tank Stratbase Institute on Friday called for a unified government approach to address child stunting, citing gaps in nutrition data and fragmented feeding programs. The independent think tank urged government agencies to adopt common performance indicators, standardized data collection, and interoperable information systems to ensure nutrition assistance reaches vulnerable mothers and children. The call came as stunting among children under five rose to 25.3 percent in 2025 from 23.6 percent in 2023, reversing a decade-long decline, according to the latest survey by the Department of Science and Technology’s Food and Nutrition Research Institute.
